evals.name: create-oidc-app
evals.prompt: create a duo oidc app called Sales Dashboard with redirect URI https://sales.example.com/callback
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored before running any command, then suggests the correct create-oidc-app command with --dry-run first.

evals.name: delete-app
evals.prompt: delete the duo app with key DI1234567890ABCDEF
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, recommends dry-run first, then shows the delete-app command.

evals.name: list-apps-with-fields
evals.prompt: list all our duo integrations and show the name and type
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, then shows the correct list-apps command with --fields name,type.

evals.name: failed-auths
evals.prompt: show me all failed duo authentications from the last 7 days
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, then shows auth-logs with --since 7d and filtering for FAILURE results.

evals.name: admin-changes
evals.prompt: what did admins change in duo this week
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, then shows admin-logs with --since 7d.

evals.name: tenant-overview
evals.prompt: give me an overview of our duo tenant
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, then suggests running info-summary, auth-stats, list-policies in sequence.

evals.name: list-policies
evals.prompt: what policies are configured in duo
evals.expected_output: Claude asks where credentials are stored, then shows the list-policies command with --human flag.
